question.question_text: As of 2023-01-01, will the monthly 30-year yield change for United States 30-year Treasury yield in 2023-01 be at least 0.3 percentage points?
question.context:
Entity: United States 30-year Treasury yield
Target period: 2023-01
Financial area: monetary_policy / long-term rates
Region: US
question.resolution_criteria: Use FRED series DGS30. Compute the change from the previous monthly observation using mode 'absolute'. Resolve yes if the change is at least 0.3 percentage points, otherwise no.
question.resolution_reasoning: The snapshotted target change was -0.32 percentage points; it resolved to 'no'.

finance.comparison_rule: target change >= median of 4 prior observed changes

resolution_document.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
resolution_document.title: 30-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
